_readme: Photographs that were fetched, looked at, and found not to show the dish.
Keyed by slug; each entry names the archive page so the fetcher can refuse
that exact file and go on to the next candidate. Without this a rejected
image is simply re-fetched on the next run, because the search that found
it the first time is deterministic — which is how warak-enab acquired the
same photograph of grape vines twice.
Reasons are kept because they are the only record of why an image is not
on the site, and the alternative is rejecting it again in six months.

Entries with "illustration": true are generated pictures that were drawn, looked at and refused. They carry the prompt rather than a source page, because there is no archive file behind them — and they exist so tools/generate_images.py does not draw them again: the same prompt and seed return the same picture, and without this record a refused drawing came straight back on the next run.
